123:t_1:83.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This coming battle... I have a feeling the anxiety I've felt until now is about to take a concrete form...」

123:t_2:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(I've broken through the protection...! First, I'll siphon as much data as possible into $$ラファエルガンダム$$!)

123:t_2:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(As I thought, the $$サイデリアル$$'s purpose in invading is $$地球の次元力$$...)

123:t_2:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(But what do they intend to do with that $$次元力$$...? If I can find that out, their next moves too...)

123:t_2:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(This is... the $$スフィア$$'s...)

123:t_2:10.en:
???
「The fun and games end here, artificial human.」

123:t_3:3.en: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

123:t_3:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「...I see. So the $$黒の騎士団$$ and the $$プリベンター$$ were also beaten in $$新日本$$ by that $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

123:t_3:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「His cunning strategy robbed $$新日本$$ of its very will to fight.」

123:t_3:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「In the end, we lost the Battle of Tokyo, and escaped abroad with General $$藤堂$$ and the others covering us.」

123:t_3:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That guy's very existence is a deadly poison. If we let a guy like that run wild, he'll wreck the world.」

123:t_3:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Just as $$ガドライト#pilot$$ amplifies the conflicting emotions deep within humans, $$バルビエル$$ has the power to amplify the hatred in people's hearts.」

123:t_3:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's the $$スフィア$$ of the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...」

123:t_3:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Because of that man, the volunteer army, in which citizens also took part, collapsed from within, and $$新日本$$, having lost its spiritual pillar, was defeated.」

123:t_3:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It was all my blunder as the commander...」

123:t_3:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But I... used $$ギアス$$ to stop the people whose hatred he had amplified...」

123:t_3:15.en:
$$オットー$$
(According to the records, $$ゼロ$$ should never have used 《$$ギアス$$》 since 《$$ゼロ・レクイエム$$》...)

123:t_3:16.en:
$$オットー$$
(From what Captain $$アムロ$$ told me, I had heard it was his own way of drawing a line over his regrets about the past...)

123:t_3:18.en:
$$オットー$$
(Like $$フル・フロンタル$$, $$ゼロ$$ wears a mask to make himself a symbol...)

123:t_3:19.en:
$$オットー$$
(But that is a vow that could be called a curse, throwing away one's whole life to fight for the people...)

123:t_3:20.en:
$$オットー$$
(To have been forced to break the seal on $$ギアス$$, one of those vows... That must have been bitter...)

123:t_3:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「You needn't say anything, $$ゼロ$$. Your regret is the regret of all of us who suffered the same defeat.」

123:t_3:23.en:
$$オットー$$
「We will bring that man down with our own hands. Without fail...!」

123:t_3:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... A new $$スフィア・リアクター$$...」

123:t_3:26.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Like 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, that man not only leads a force of his own, he also seems to hold an important position within the Empire.」

123:t_3:27.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$新日本$$ has fallen, and now the North American front, which failed to take $$セントラル・ベース$$, will be pushed far back too...」

123:t_3:29.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「We've detected the $$サイデリアル$$ approaching! Captain, please come up to the bridge right away!」

123:t_3:30.en:
$$オットー$$
「All hands, you heard that! It seems those guys have no intention of letting us get away!」

123:t_3:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They're going after us instead of the fight against the $$連邦軍$$ in North America...!」

123:t_3:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What's going to happen to us...?」

123:t_3:33.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's not about what happens...! It's about what we do!」

123:t_3:35.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If they want a fight, we'll take it! If they target a single unit, the distortion of that strategy will make them destroy themselves sooner or later!」

123:t_3:37.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We will never yield. We will survive without fail and continue our resistance.」

123:t_3:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, prepare to sortie...! Hurry!」

123:t_3:41.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$n... Before that, there is something I have to tell you.」

123:t_3:43.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「When I gathered information on the Empire at $$セントラル・ベース$$, seizing $$スフィア$$s was listed among their key strategies.」

123:t_3:45.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Be careful, $n. In the battles ahead, the Empire will come after your $$スフィア$$.」

123:t_3:47.en:
$n
「The $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... And my $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$...」

123:t_3:48.en:
$n
「Is this... what was behind the anxiety I've been feeling...?」

123:t_10:4.en:
$n
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. The $$サイデリアル$$ are here. Save the talk for later.」

123:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems you are bothered by what $$ティエリア$$ told you.」

123:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it seems that goes for that $$バルビエル$$ as well. That man... showed considerable interest in the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

123:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z born when $n fought that man... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

123:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Battles over the $$スフィア$$s... I'm sure they will produce many $$Ｚチップ$$.」

123:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And when those have been gathered... that will surely be the time of the true battle among us, $n, and them...」

123:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems everyone is busy intercepting the $$サイデリアル$$.」

123:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I too shall cooperate, in my capacity as a dimensional merchant... I'll provide the $$サーペント$$ I had stocked up free of charge.」

123:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business without a break again today! Now then, let's give it our all... business, business!」

123:t_10:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...What do you make of it?」

123:t_10:18.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're right, of course. When I sharpen my senses, I can feel such things.」

123:t_10:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I want a little more time to organize my thoughts.」

123:t_10:23.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're unusually vague. But all I can do here is leave it to you.」

123:t_10:24.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The dimensional merchant $$ＡＧ$$... If he holds the answer to the questions inside you...」

123:t_10:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Pinning down his true identity will carry great significance for the future of the world...」

124:t_000:1.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ have started fighting in the surrounding area too.」

124:t_000:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Good...! In the meantime, we take down $$セントラル・ベース$$!」

124:t_000:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Everyone, confirm the operation once more!」
